sentences.text: Paraetmopterus was an extinct shark belonging to the class Chondrichthyes and the family Etmopteridae.
This genus sits within the broader group known as Etmopteridae.
Adnet described the genus in 2006, naming the type species P. nolfi after fossils found in France during the middle Eocene.
A second species, P. horvathi from Slovakia, was described in 2013 but later moved to the separate genus Palaeocentroscymnus.
These sharks lived between 48.07 and 37.71 million years ago, spanning the Lutetian to Bartonian stages.
